thread:
megan: hey team — just finished my first day, welcome! quick issue: my USB Wi-Fi dongle (order #RDW-3321) wasn't in the box. laptop has ethernet but i'm in a hot desk area with flaky wall jack. anyone know who to ping for shipping follow-up? :wave:

it_rafael: welcome aboard megan :tada: sorry about that. can you confirm the packing slip number and desk location? i'll check the asset tracker and ping logistics. if you need immediate connectivity i can provision a guest Wi-Fi account or lend a spare dongle for the afternoon.

megan: packing slip shows RDW-3321, shipped Monday. desk is 3A (North wing). guest Wi-Fi would be great for meetings — thanks.

ops_kim: tagging logistics — we saw a partial fulfillment on that shipment. tracking: https://ship.example/track/ZX12345 shows "out for delivery" but no POD. i'll open a follow-up case with the carrier. if delivery fails today we can ship an expedited replacement tomorrow AM.

it_rafael: in the meantime, here's a quick guest network flow: connect to Redwood-Guest, open the browser and accept TOS, then SMS code to your mobile. creds expire after 8 hours. if you prefer a dongle loan, @ops_kim can drop one by 15:30.

megan: can do guest Wi-Fi for now. FYI when i plug my CalDigit dock i get no Wi-Fi interfaces showing — maybe the dongle would help for roaming. here's the output of nmcli when dock is attached:

```
DEVICE  TYPE      STATE      CONNECTION 
eth0    ethernet  connected  Wired connection 1
wlan0   wifi      unmanaged  --
usb0    ethernet  disconnected --
```

it_rafael: nmcli shows the wifi device is unmanaged (likely NetworkManager config from company image). quick workaround: sudo nmcli device set wlan0 managed yes (you might need admin) — but we prefer not to give sudo on first day. i'll run a temporary policy to allow network-manager toggle via SSM. alternatively plug the dongle and see if it enumerates as wlan1.

it-bot: Ticket TKT-4890 created: "Missing USB Wi-Fi dongle — expedited ship if carrier fails". Assigned to Logistics.

megan: awesome, thanks all. i'll try the guest Wi-Fi and update here. appreciate the fast help :smile:
metadata: new hire onboarding IT support - missing peripheral, shipping follow-up, temporary guest wifi
